title: IVG Smart Max Green Apple Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Green Apple delivers a bright, sharp fruit flavour that captures the tartness of freshly sliced apples. The profile is punchy and refreshing, with a clean finish that makes it an easy all-day vape for fans of crisp, sour fruits. Each pack includes a 2ml pod filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once assembled, the refill feeds the pod automatically to support up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on your usage. No refilling or coil swaps required. The pod uses mesh coil technology to maintain smooth vapour and clear flavour from first puff to last. Made exclusively for the IVG Smart Max Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill and press firmly until they click together. Insert the connected pod and refill into the Smart Max device.
